text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Those around me offer a lot of support as I prepare for the Oka Sho. Sky comes to check on me, too. ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: On top of that, after entering my classic year, I became fast enough to attract even Sakura Bakushin O's attention!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr also tells me I'm like the wind! I couldn't ask for higher praise from her! ♪ Now I feel more than ready to take on the Oka Sho!
